legalMoves.description: Smyth's reward: take Metal Platforms free (cost and prerequisite waived) — All robot platforms gain +1 DEF. Heroes are not affected. This does not give statless pieces a combat stat line.

Smyth's reward: take Extra Build Card free (cost and prerequisite waived) — Gain a second Build action card for the rest of the game (with Quartermaster's, three). Counts as a research type for technology without raising the target (ruling #87).

Smyth's reward: take Extra Move/Battle Card free (cost and prerequisite waived) — Gain a second Move/Battle action card for the rest of the game (with Marshal's, three). Counts as a research type for technology without raising the target (ruling #87).

Smyth's reward: take Extra Research Card free (cost and prerequisite waived) — Gain a second Research action card for the rest of the game (with Archivist's, three). Counts as a research type for technology without raising the target (ruling #87).
